newsitem.title: USA: Wallace sees Q3 sales, EPS below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Wallace sees Q3 sales, EPS below estimates.

text.p: Wallace Computer Services Inc said Thursday it expects its fiscal third quarter results to be higher than the year-ago quarter but lower than the analysts' consensus estimate before changes made Thursday.
Wallace said the large volume of shares traded on Thursday was the result of analysts changing estimates for the company's third and fourth fiscal quarters. Fiscal 1997 ends July 31, 1997.
Wallace Computer shares closed down 4-1/4 at 25-5/8, with 1.45 million shares trading hands.

"The company expects that third quarter sales and earnings per share results should exceed the prior year's quarter, however, they are expected to be less than the consensus analysts' expectations before today's changes," Wallace Computer said in a statement.
The company said it will hold a shareholders' conference call at 1100 CDT Friday.
According to First Call, the consensus of analysts' estimates for fiscal third quarter earnings was $0.50 a share versus $0.41 a share the prior year.
